headline: Full Stack Developer & E-Commerce Specialist | Python, Node.js & Web Applications
summary: Versatile Full Stack Developer with a proven track record of engineering and deploying 150+ successful web projects across 12+ countries. Specializes in building robust backends, automated systems, and scalable web applications using Python, Node.js, and PostgreSQL. Experienced in integrating payment gateways, optimizing website performance, and implementing server-side tracking for data-driven insights. Combines technical depth with a strong understanding of business operations and digital marketing funnels to deliver high-impact, client-focused solutions in remote and distributed environments.

experience.title: Full Stack Developer & Creative Strategist
bullets: Engineered and deployed 150+ successful web projects across 12+ countries, achieving 100% client satisfaction through robust backend architecture and seamless frontend experiences.
Developed complex web applications using Python, Node.js, and PostgreSQL, delivering scalable solutions in rapid 5-12 day development cycles.
Implemented secure payment gateway integrations and optimized e-commerce workflows to enhance user conversion and transaction reliability.

cover_letter: I am writing to express my strong interest in the Senior Shopify Developer position at Sanctuary Computer Inc. With over 150 successful web projects delivered across 12 countries, I bring extensive expertise in full-stack development, specifically in building robust e-commerce backends and optimizing user experiences. My background in integrating payment gateways, managing Linux servers, and developing scalable Node.js and Python applications aligns perfectly with your technical requirements. I am eager to leverage my skills in web performance optimization and secure coding to drive growth for Sanctuary Computer Inc. I look forward to discussing how my technical precision and business acumen can contribute to your team's success.
